question: When can the frozen prismatic B-Rep evidence a blind or through cylindrical cut extent?

measurement.scope: single cylindrical face, axis parallel to +Z, exactly two adjacent planar faces, frozen prismatic-hole-v1 geometry
reported_fields: adjacent planar face bbox, area, XY footprint
measurement.blind: Exactly one adjacent planar face has a local XY footprint no larger than 1.25 times the measured cylinder diameter and the other is exterior-sized.
measurement.through: Both adjacent planar faces are exterior-sized.
measurement.fail_closed: Any other cylindrical count, axis, terminal-face cardinality, or footprint combination is unsupported.

boundaries: The reporter is offline-only and not part of the public probe contract.
Only the frozen +Z single-cylinder prismatic scope is supported.
No feature label or reference-script variant is an input fact.
No generic feature recognition, history recovery, runtime helper, manifest or provider use follows.

runtime_projection.review_trigger: Independent direct runtime evidence and a separate adoption review are required.
